ribbonMeasurements.tooltip: Automatically turn the measure tool Off when you leave this ribbon: switching to another ribbon tab, or changing layout via the App Layout ribbon or the F-keys. Keeps a measuring mode from staying armed while you work elsewhere, where every click would otherwise place a measurement point. Turn it off to keep the tool armed across ribbon and layout switches. Default on.

ribbonMeasurements.label: X-axis
ribbonMeasurements.tooltip: Next point moves only along X from the previous point

ribbonMeasurements.label: Perpendicular
ribbonMeasurements.tooltip: Next point moves straight out along the last point's surface normal

ribbonMeasurements.label: Y-axis
ribbonMeasurements.tooltip: Next point moves only along Y from the previous point

ribbonMeasurements.label: Parallel
ribbonMeasurements.tooltip: Next point stays in the last point's surface plane

ribbonMeasurements.label: Z-axis
ribbonMeasurements.tooltip: Next point moves only along Z from the previous point
